title: Local testing of perpendicular characters
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $H$ be a subspace of $bF_2^n$, and write $H^perp$ for its orthogonal complement under the usual dot product. Consider the class of sign-valued functions $g$ on $bF_2^n$ of the form $g(z)=(-1)^{\langle\eta,z\rangle}$ for some $beta\in H^perp$, and the three-query tester associated with a coordinate decomposition of $bF_2^n$ having $H$ as its first factor. The tester accepts every function in this class with probability $1$; moreover, for every $\epsilon\in[0,1]$ and every sign-valued function $f$ whose relative Hamming distance from each function in the class is greater than $\epsilon$, its rejection probability is greater than $\epsilon$.
